analysis_walkthrough.business_objective_summary: The objective is to enhance the recovery rate of the Contractor module by implementing a reference resolver and conducting a third pass verification.
requirements_understanding: The focus is on improving the recovery rate for the Contractor module.
A reference resolver needs to be implemented.
A third pass verification process should be conducted.
conversion_to_technical_requirements: Implement a reference resolver to handle dependencies and references within the Contractor module.
Conduct a third pass verification to ensure completeness and accuracy.
Focus on error handling and observability to track the recovery process.
clarifications_requested: What specific metrics define a successful recovery rate improvement?
Are there existing benchmarks for the recovery rate?

executive_summary: The project aims to enhance the recovery rate of the Contractor module by implementing a reference resolver and conducting a third pass verification.

functional_requirements.title: Implement Reference Resolver
functional_requirements.description: Develop a reference resolver to manage and resolve dependencies within the Contractor module.
acceptance_criteria: The reference resolver correctly identifies all dependencies.
The resolver can handle circular dependencies without errors.
All resolved references are logged for audit purposes.

functional_requirements.title: Conduct Third Pass Verification
functional_requirements.description: Perform a third pass verification to ensure the Contractor module's recovery rate is improved.
acceptance_criteria: The third pass verification identifies any unresolved references.
Verification results are documented and reviewed by the QA team.
All identified issues are resolved before deployment.

functional_requirements.title: Enhance Error Handling
functional_requirements.description: Implement enhanced error handling mechanisms in the Contractor module.
acceptance_criteria: All errors are logged with sufficient detail for troubleshooting.
Users receive clear error messages when issues occur.
Error handling mechanisms are tested under load conditions.

functional_requirements.title: Improve Observability
functional_requirements.description: Integrate observability tools to monitor the Contractor module's performance and recovery rate.
acceptance_criteria: Observability tools provide real-time metrics on recovery rate.
Alerts are configured for recovery rate anomalies.
Dashboards display key performance indicators for the module.

functional_requirements.title: Automate Recovery Rate Reporting
functional_requirements.description: Automate the generation of reports on the Contractor module's recovery rate.
acceptance_criteria: Reports are generated daily and distributed to stakeholders.
Reports include historical trends and current metrics.
Stakeholders can customize report parameters.

functional_requirements.title: Integrate with Existing Systems
functional_requirements.description: Ensure the Contractor module integrates seamlessly with existing systems.
acceptance_criteria: Integration tests confirm compatibility with existing systems.
Data exchange between systems is verified for accuracy.
No existing system functionality is disrupted by the integration.

non_functional_requirements.title: Performance Optimization
non_functional_requirements.description: Optimize the Contractor module to ensure it performs efficiently under load.
non_functional_requirements.metric: Module response time < 200ms under peak load
acceptance_criteria: Performance tests confirm response time under 200ms.
No performance degradation during peak hours.
Scalability tests show consistent performance with increased load.
non_functional_requirements.verification: Load test at 10× expected peak; measure p95/p99

non_functional_requirements.title: Security Compliance
non_functional_requirements.description: Ensure the Contractor module meets security compliance requirements.
acceptance_criteria: No critical vulnerabilities found in security audits.
All data is encrypted in transit and at rest.
Access controls are verified and enforced.

non_functional_requirements.title: Usability
non_functional_requirements.description: Ensure the Contractor module is user-friendly and accessible.
acceptance_criteria: User testing results in a satisfaction score above 4.5.
Accessibility tests confirm compliance with WCAG 2.1 AA.
User feedback is collected and addressed in iterations.

blocking.question: Target application architecture for the modernization
blocking.default_recommendation: Start with a modular monolith unless there is a clear reason to decompose immediately.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Early coupling / drift that is expensive to correct downstream.

blocking.question: Database contract strategy during migration
blocking.default_recommendation: Preserve contracts initially and modernize behind a compatibility layer.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Business rule drift and data-side regressions.

blocking.question: Authentication / authorization strategy for the modern target
blocking.default_recommendation: Model current auth behavior first, then move to a clearer standards-based target with explicit compatibility rules.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Authorization regressions and lost session context during cutover.
